name: ZCA_OML_JOB_STATISTICS
description: This table stores multiple run versions of a Model to capture metrics.

columns.name: JOB_RUN_ID
columns.description: This is the Primary Key of the Table.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: This is the Foreign Key to table zca_oml_jobs

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATISTICS_TYPE
columns.description: This column stores the statistics type

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the Data Source Name of the Object, like accounts, leads etc.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This column contains type of the Data Source, e.g "Rest", "Table", View" etc.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the User Enterable Job Name.

columns.name: MODEL_TYPE
columns.description: This column stores the Model Type values, such as "CLASSIFICATION", "REGRESSION" or "CLUSTERING".

columns.name: MODEL_ACCURACY
columns.description: This column stores the Model accuracy value.

columns.name: SELECTED_ALGORITHM
columns.description: This column stores the final selected algorithm name for the model built.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_SQL
columns.description: This column stores the SQL generated by the Model.

columns.name: RANGE_VALUES
columns.description: This column contains the Bucket Range values for multiple NUMBER and DATE columns.

columns.name: EXPLAINABILITY_METRICS
columns.description: This column stores the explainability metrics JSON  generated by the Model.

columns.name: MODEL_STATUS
columns.description: This column contains the status flag of the job run for model creation.The statis of the Machine learning Models can be DRAFT,RUNNING,ERROR,READY,ACTIVE.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_METADATA_JSON
columns.description: This column stores any extra information regarding the  job.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
